biography.value:
Prophetess of the Lady. A lord presence from the Kingdom of Bretonnia, built for brutal, legible table play. Its numbers are recalibrated from a PF2e-style creature benchmark and mapped back onto D&D challenge expectations.

Rules Profile. AC 20; HP 306; proficiency +5; save DC 19. Linked armory entries: 16. Linked spell entries: 2.

"A warrior is measured when the line begins to break."
- Old World battlefield saying

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e
